question.text: Term Money Market covers tenors from:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 8.2.3: Overnight (1 day); Notice (2-14 days); Term (15 days – 1 year). The Trap: Overnight/Notice cover shorter tenors. Cross-Exam Context: Same classifications in IV/I. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Categorize money-market positions accordingly for cash-flow planning.
